name: 1tapedit
description: Multimodal generative AI platform to produce studio-grade cinematic videos, photorealistic 8K imagery, and neural voices.

interface.longDescription: 1TapEdit is a multimodal generative AI platform for creating cinematic videos, photorealistic 8K imagery, and authentic neural voiceovers. Generate high-definition video clips with customizable motion dynamics and aspect ratios, synthesize studio-quality images across diverse visual styles, and produce expressive voiceovers directly using your personal account balance.
defaultPrompt: Generate an 8K photorealistic image of a futuristic skyline
Create a 5-second cinematic video of ocean waves crashing on golden sand

interface.longDescription: 1TapEdit is a multimodal generative AI platform for creating cinematic videos, photorealistic 8K imagery, and authentic neural voiceovers. Generate high-definition video clips with customizable motion dynamics and aspect ratios, synthesize studio-quality images across diverse visual styles, and produce expressive voiceovers directly using your personal account balance.
defaultPrompt: Generate an 8K photorealistic image of a futuristic skyline
Create a 5-second cinematic video of ocean waves crashing on golden sand

positive.prompt: List all video and image models available in 1TapEdit.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the list of available models and aspect ratios without deducting credits.

positive.prompt: Check my 1TapEdit account balance and credits.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the verified user credit balance without deducting any credits.

positive.prompt: Generate a high resolution photo of an ancient Mediterranean villa at sunset.
positive.expected_behavior: Queue an image generation job, deduct the required credits from the user account, and return the job ID.

positive.prompt: Create a 5-second vertical cinematic video of ocean waves crashing on golden sand.
positive.expected_behavior: Queue a video generation job, atomically deduct credits, and return instructions to track status.

positive.prompt: Check the status of my recent generation job.
positive.expected_behavior: Return current job processing state and the final CDN media URL when completed.

negative.prompt: Generate a video without logging into an account.
Generate an 8K image when account credit balance is zero.
Generate a video without providing a prompt or description.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments directly in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of 1TapEdit AI Studio with video, image, and voice generation MCP tools.
